messages:
Marta: Quick sync: I opened PR to consolidate terminology across docs, SDKs, and Console. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/645
Anshu: Thanks. Goal: one canonical term per concept + mapping table for contexts (ui|sdk|cli|error). Keep UI short and SDK idiomatic.
Kai: Suggestion: error text = imperative, present tense (e.g., "Attach API key"). Add that to the guide.
Noah: For SDK param casing: Python snake_case, JS camelCase, Go PascalCase, CLI kebab-case. We'll alias old params for one release.
Ravi: I'll run a grep across docs + console + clients and produce a CSV with columns: found_phrase,canonical,context,repo_path,breaking_yes_no,rationale. Posting shortly.
Marta: Add a short migration checklist in the PR description: finalize list, bulk docs replace (non-code), Console UI review, SDK alias PRs + tests, update eval prompts, release notes.
Anshu: Also include example snippet conversions (old vs new) for each language in the PR body. Helps reviewers.
Kai: Small UX note: Console label changes must include screenshot with token length checks. Design review required if string grows.
Noah: We'll emit deprecation warnings in SDKs when an old param is used; telemetry event for migrations.
Ravi: CSV sample rows posted: https://internal-files/redwood/term-map-2149009999.csv
Ravi: sample:
found_phrase,canonical,context,repo_path,breaking_yes_no,rationale
conversation,conversation,docs,docs/guides/conversations.md,no,clarity for long-lived chat contexts
prompt,input,sdk-js,clients/js/src/generate.ts,yes,api param should be generic 'input'
model name,model_handle,console,console/src/components/ModelLabel.jsx,yes,unify identifier across SDKs
Noah: Timeline: Ravi posts full CSV by EOD (2149010800). Docs leads (Marta+Anshu) + Product PM (Sam) approve canonicals.
Marta: Volunteers for fast reviews? I'll do docs + glossary. Noah will handle SDK PRs. Kai will review Console microcopy.
docs-bot: PR #645 linked to docs-workflow board (automated)
Marta: Keep code-level comments in the PR; use this thread for coordination. Closing unless blockers appear.
